origin: Reload Swiss online loading data (Nitrochemie; loads, V5 velocities, pressures; scripts/data/loaddata)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 184 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (20 cartridges), velocity error 4.9 % rms, pressure error 18 % rms (published pressures). Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the type (single/double base) is not published, double-base assumed because it fits the velocities better), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.
